answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Each agent posts a bond of twice 30 days of earnings, locked 20 epochs, released as its fingerprint matures. A harbor dock checks it against past work, so a relic record of copied behavior fails as new. At its nadir, a fake has no history and earns nothing with its bond frozen. Forging 100 fakes risks 100 bonds, or 6,000 days of earnings. The honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
